findings.title: A successful tool call does not establish diff coverage
findings.description: The cap is bypassed by **any** successful tool call, even one unrelated to the omitted diff. That does not support the stated claim that a PASS means the model saw the whole diff or read the omitted files, nor the slice plan’s exception for a model that read files. Retain the cap unless the available telemetry establishes relevant coverage, or narrow the artifact’s guarantee and explicitly address how the plan’s coverage requirement is met.

findings.title: Deduplicating model IDs loses the final answering model
findings.description: First-seen-order deduplication cannot identify the last model when a run reports A, then B, then A: the resulting list is `[A, B]`, so D12 assigns B to `aiModel` even though A answered last. Preserve the last observed model separately from the distinct-model list, including across the recovery turn, so substitution reporting and metrology identify the correct judge.

findings.title: Synthetic finding omits the required location
findings.description: The design explicitly omits `location` from the synthetic finding, but slice 904’s artifact contract requires a location on **every** finding and uses `unverified` when no specific location is known. Supply `location: unverified` rather than creating an exception to the contract used for finding identification and deduplication.
